draft_review.summary: The poster is a clear, bounded visual reminder to rest the eyes. Its concise caption and gentle instruction are understandable, and all supplied machine checks pass. The deterministic evidence supports the layout and accessibility checks; it does not demonstrate rendering in a live browser.
draft_review.improvement: Add a small, high-contrast cue such as a window or horizon to make “look up” and “find far” more immediately visible in the illustration.

final_review.summary: The bounded poster presents a clear, brief eye-rest cue with understandable instructions. The added window and crossbars make the “look up” idea more visible, and all supplied deterministic machine checks pass. The evidence does not establish live browser rendering.
final_review.improvement: Consider adding a simple distant horizon or landscape in the window so the “find far” instruction is reflected more directly in the illustration.
